bodyMarkdown:
## Highlights

- Onboarding is smoother and easier to follow
- Choosing apps for your Shield is now faster and more intuitive
- Better layout and spacing on smaller screens

## Improvements

- Improved consistency across different devices
- Cleaner visuals with more refined spacing and typography
- Shield setup is now faster and more reliable
- General polish and stability improvements
- Better performance across the app

## Why this matters

Setup & Onboarding Smoother (v4.1.2) is one of those tidy-up releases that does not need a parade, but it still helps the Shield feel less fussy. Small fixes matter here because CogniFocus is supposed to get out of your way fast. Tap in, start the thing, dodge the scroll spiral, continue your tiny heroic quest. That is the whole deal.

- Onboarding is smoother and easier to follow gets a little more room to breathe.
- Choosing apps for your Shield is now faster and more intuitive gets a little more room to breathe.
- Better layout and spacing on smaller screens gets a little more room to breathe.
- Improved consistency across different devices gets a little more room to breathe.

So yes, this is a smaller note. The point is still real: fewer weird little moments, clearer feedback, and less friction between you and the session you meant to start. The Goblin may still be dramatic about it, obviously, but the app should feel calmer where it counts.
